levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى بن زكريا القطان

notes: «عن أبيه العباس بن عبد المطلب» is one link named by the name (rule 7).
The long Bahira episode is the scene and the words of the monk and the Prophet; Abu Talib, who says «خرجت» in the first person, is the last link.
«قالوا» at the head joins three co-transmitters at one level.
